thread:
nora: Quick sync summary 1 — customers want private installs that preserve their egress IPs and upgrades that don't break traffic. Keeping notes here.
sam: Proposal: three delivery lanes - (1) operator-preserve (daemonset/hostNetwork), (2) relay-fallback for NATed sites, (3) offline bundle with KMS/HSM options.
kai: Operator detail: hostNetwork daemonset is lowest-friction to preserve source IP but has RBAC/security implications. TPROXY/iptable bypass is more flexible but needs kernel support.
devon: Draft acceptance criteria: upgrade success >=98% in automation harness; rollback median <=10m for 90% cases; egress preserved in >=90% hostNetwork installs; KMS onboarding docs + examples for at least two vendors.
sam: Minimal preflight checklist: outbound connectivity, CA bundles present, KMS handshake test, disk space. Example check: curl -sf https://status.redwood.local/ok || echo "connectivity-fail".
devon: Test matrix to validate: single-node airgapped, NATed VPC, VPC with egress retention, hybrid peered DC. Collect install time, upgrade delta, rollback time, token latency p95.
nora: Rollout gates suggestion: internal beta (1-2 customers) -> small canary (3-5) -> GA with runbook and signed off owners. Owners: sam (operator), kai (network), devon (docs + canary). Product signoff by Monday please.
ops-bot: Maintenance window reserved: 2024-09-15 02:00-05:00 UTC (automated).
sam: Ack, will start operator spike tomorrow and post updates here.
